title: Nashville nature oasis near downtown Opry &airport
description:
This charming house is one of a kind & very convenient - 15-20 minutes from downtown, 10 minutes from BNA airport, 10 minutes from Opryland/Grand Ole Opry. 

Half acre with deer, birds, & hummingbirds daily! Bird seed & hummingbird nectar left for renters to keep the birds coming! This 3 bedroom house can sleep up to 10 people (3 queen beds & 2 couches). Washer dryer. Renovated bath & kitchen, kitchen stocked with all utensils/equipment. Fenced backyard for dogs. TVs, Puzzles, & games included!

The space
Brick rancher with 3 bedrooms, 1 full renovated bath, one full renovated kitchen, one original living room and one bonus room that has a living area and a dining room with full table/chairs, games, cards, puzzles, tv, etc.

Guest access
Can use all rooms in the house and all of the yard and parking.

Other things to note
The fireplace is not functional and for decoration only, there is also a sign on it saying this. Thank you!
